tools.name: check_mesh_quality
tools.description: Computes skewness, aspect ratio and orthogonality statistics and reports whether the mesh passes the skewness limit. Read-only. Run first: generate_mesh. Produces: MeshQualityReport. Note: read-only.

max_skewness.description: Largest acceptable cell skewness; 0 is perfect, 1 is degenerate.

tools.name: configure_solver
tools.description: Chooses the discretisation scheme, iteration budget and convergence tolerance; refuses meshes that failed the quality check. Run first: check_mesh_quality, set_boundary_conditions. Produces: SolverConfig.

convergence_tolerance.description: Normalised residual below which the run counts as converged.

max_iterations.description: Iteration budget before the solver stops.

scheme.description: Spatial discretisation order for convective terms.

tools.name: export_results
tools.description: Writes solution fields to disk as CSV, VTK or HDF5; can overwrite an existing file when overwrite is true. Run first: run_solver. Produces: ResultsExport. Note: can overwrite data.

format.description: File format for the exported results.

output_path.description: Destination file path on the server.

overwrite.description: Replace the destination file if it already exists.

tools.name: extract_forces
tools.description: Integrates surface pressure and shear from the solution to give lift, drag and moment coefficients for a reference area. Run first: run_solver. Produces: ForceCoefficients.

reference_area.description: Area used to non-dimensionalise forces, e.g. wing planform area. Unit: m2.

tools.name: generate_mesh
tools.description: Builds a volume mesh around the clean geometry, including prism layers for the boundary layer. Can take several minutes on large models. Run first: repair_geometry. Produces: Mesh. Note: long running.

global_size.description: Target element edge length away from the surface. Unit: mm.

boundary_layers.description: Number of prism layers grown from wall surfaces.

growth_rate.description: Ratio of the thickness of successive prism layers.

mesh_type.description: Element topology used for the volume mesh.

tools.name: import_geometry
tools.description: Loads a CAD or surface file (STEP or STL) into a new AeroFlow session and sets the length unit of the model. Produces: Geometry.

file_path.description: Path to a .step or .stl file readable by the server.

length_unit.description: Unit in which the file's coordinates are expressed.

tools.name: monitor_convergence
tools.description: Reads the residual history and reports whether the run converged, plateaued or diverged over a trailing window. Read-only. Run first: run_solver. Produces: ConvergenceSummary. Note: read-only.

window.description: Number of final iterations used to judge the trend.

tools.name: predict_with_surrogate
tools.description: Predicts lift and drag coefficients for new flow conditions in milliseconds using the trained surrogate. Read-only. Run first: train_surrogate. Produces: SurrogatePrediction. Note: read-only.

angle_of_attack.description: Angle of attack to predict for. Unit: deg.

inlet_velocity.description: Speed of the incoming air to predict for. Unit: m/s.

tools.name: record_design_point
tools.description: Appends the current inputs and force coefficients as one row of a parametric dataset used to train surrogates. Run first: extract_forces. Produces: ParametricDataset.

dataset_path.description: CSV file that accumulates design points.

tools.name: repair_geometry
tools.description: Stitches gaps, removes sliver faces and optionally fills holes so the surface is watertight and ready for meshing. Run first: import_geometry. Produces: CleanGeometry.

fill_holes.description: Close remaining open boundaries with planar patches.

tolerance.description: Maximum gap that is closed when stitching faces. Unit: mm.

tools.name: run_solver
tools.description: Runs the steady-state flow solver on the configured case and writes solution fields and a residual history. Long running. Run first: configure_solver. Produces: ConvergenceHistory, SolutionFields. Note: long running.

num_cores.description: Number of CPU cores allocated to the solver.

restart.description: Initialise from the last stored solution instead of freestream values.

tools.name: set_boundary_conditions
tools.description: Defines freestream velocity, outlet pressure, angle of attack, temperature and the turbulence model for an external-flow case. Run first: generate_mesh. Produces: BoundaryConditionSet.

inlet_velocity.description: Speed of the incoming air, far from the body. Unit: m/s.

angle_of_attack.description: Angle between the freestream and the body reference axis. Unit: deg.

outlet_pressure.description: Gauge static pressure applied at the outlet boundary. Unit: Pa.

reference_temperature.description: Freestream static temperature of the air. Unit: K.

turbulence_model.description: Closure model used by the solver for turbulent flow.

tools.name: train_surrogate
tools.description: Fits a data-driven surrogate of the solver on the parametric dataset and reports validation error. Long running. Run first: record_design_point. Produces: SurrogateModel. Note: long running.

model_type.description: Regression family used for the surrogate.

validation_split.description: Fraction of design points held out to estimate error. Unit: fraction.
